name: implement-parameter-combinations
details:
Implement 4 approved parameter combinations from PARAMETER-COMBINATIONS-IMPLEMENTATION.md:
1. create with optional file_text (create empty file)
2. insert with optional insert_line (append to end)
3. delete with old_str/old_string (delete matching text)
4. str_replace empty string deletion (document existing behavior)

All specifications are complete and approved by janbam. This is pure implementation work with comprehensive testing.

tasks.name: Schema Updates
tasks.details:
Update Zod schemas in BOTH unified and individual tool modes.

Files:
- src/server/mcp-server.ts

Changes:
1. CreateCommandSchema: file_text optional with .default('')
2. InsertCommandSchema: insert_line optional
3. DeleteCommandSchema: add old_str/old_string optional params
4. StrReplaceCommandSchema: update descriptions for empty string deletion

Must update BOTH:
- Individual schemas (76-116)
- Unified schema MemoryCommandSchema (21-64)

tasks.name: Interface Updates
tasks.details:
Update TypeScript interfaces in operations.ts to match new optional parameters.

File: src/memory/operations.ts

Changes:
1. CreateCommand: file_text?: string
2. InsertCommand: insert_line?: number
3. DeleteCommand: add old_str?: string, old_string?: string

tasks.name: Handler Implementation
tasks.details:
Implement logic for new parameter combinations.

File: src/memory/operations.ts

Changes:
1. insert(): Handle missing insert_line (append to end) - lines 362-408
2. deleteOp(): Add validation for parameter conflicts - lines 417-513
3. deleteOp(): Implement deleteMatchingText() helper
4. Add escapeRegExp() utility function

No changes needed for create() - default value handles it.

tasks.name: Test Implementation
tasks.details:
Add ~12 comprehensive tests to test/memory-operations.test.ts

Tests:
- 3 tests for create with optional file_text
- 3 tests for insert with optional insert_line  
- 6 tests for delete with old_str (including regex escaping)
- 1 test for str_replace empty string deletion (verify exists)

Target: 100 → 112 passing tests

tasks.name: Documentation Updates

Update README and CHANGELOG with new features.

tasks.name: Manual Testing
tasks.details:
Test with actual MCP tooling to verify both modes work.

Tests:
1. Unified tool mode (default)
2. One-tool-per-command mode
3. Edge cases: empty files, special characters, multiple occurrences
4. Verify all 4 features work as specified

Use MCP-Debug if available, otherwise request user to reconnect MCP.
